app.name: Picsart AI Photo Editor, Video
app.description: A popular AI-powered photo and video editing app with creative tools, templates, filters, and a social community for sharing creations.

verdict.one_liner: Heavy ad tracking and broad data sharing overshadow strong protections for biometric data.
verdict.summary: Picsart collects extensive personal data including contacts, location, device info, and facial geometry for photo editing effects. The app shares data with advertising networks and service providers, uses interest-based advertising, and does not honor 'Do Not Track' signals. On the positive side, TrueDepth data never leaves the device, and biometric data is not sold.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app aggressively tracks your behavior for ads, uploads your contacts if you allow it, and shares data with advertising networks. While it has some good protections for biometric data, the overall tracking and sharing practices are concerning for privacy-conscious users.

red.title: Interest-based advertising tracks you across apps and websites
red.plain_english: The policy says Picsart uses your personal information to show you targeted ads based on your activity, both inside the app and on other platforms. Your data is shared with ad networks to make ads more relevant to you.

red.title: Your contact list can be uploaded to their servers
red.plain_english: If you give permission, Picsart accesses and stores your device's contact list to help you find friends. This means names, phone numbers, and emails from your contacts are uploaded to Picsart's servers.

red.title: Data shared with ad networks and subsidiaries
red.plain_english: The policy says your information is shared with advertising networks, service providers, and Picsart's subsidiaries and affiliates. Some of this sharing is for delivering targeted ads.

red.title: 'Do Not Track' signals are ignored
red.plain_english: The policy explicitly states that their systems do not recognize 'Do Not Track' signals from your browser, meaning you cannot easily stop tracking through browser settings alone.

red.title: Facial geometry data stored for up to 3 years
red.plain_english: When you use face effects, Picsart collects facial geometry data. While they do not sell it, they store it on their servers and only destroy it after your account becomes inactive for 3 years.

green.title: TrueDepth camera data never leaves your device
green.plain_english: Data collected through Apple's TrueDepth API for camera effects is used only in real time on your device. It is never stored, shared, or sent to Picsart's servers.

green.title: Biometric data is explicitly not sold
green.plain_english: The policy promises that Picsart will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from your facial geometry or biometric data.

green.title: Opt-out tools for targeted advertising are provided
green.plain_english: You can opt out of interest-based advertising through industry tools like the DAA Webchoices and Appchoices programs, and you can disable your advertising identifier in your device settings.

green.title: You can request deletion of your personal information
green.plain_english: Picsart offers a Privacy Request Form and email contact where you can ask to delete your personal information or exercise other data rights.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Camera and microphone are used when you actively take photos or record videos for editing. TrueDepth data for face effects is processed locally and never leaves your device.
categories.detail: Camera access is core to the photo editing functionality. TrueDepth API data is used in real time for face effects and is not persistently stored or shared.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you have an Apple iOS device and use the camera function with our services, we may automatically collect data about the spatial positioning of a person's head or face within an image frame using Apple's TrueDepth API. None of the data collected via TrueDepth API ever leaves your device.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Picsart approximates your location from your IP address or device settings when you create an account. You may also add geotags to photos you choose to share publicly.
categories.detail: Location is collected at account setup from IP address or device settings. Geotag metadata may be attached to user content if the user chooses.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also require data about your location, which we approximate from your IP address or device settings.
concerns: Location inferred from IP address at account creation
Geotags on photos may be publicly searchable

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you give permission, Picsart accesses and stores your contact list on its servers to help you find friends and invite them to the app.
categories.detail: Contact list access is optional and user-initiated. Contacts are uploaded to Picsart servers for friend-finding and sharing features. Information from connected social accounts is also used.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your permission (on download or within one of our apps), we may access and store your device's contact list to help you find your friends on Picsart, invite them to Picsart, or to share your content with them.
concerns: Contact list uploaded to Picsart servers
Data from connected social accounts also collected

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Picsart needs access to your photos and videos so you can edit them. You choose which files to open or save.
categories.detail: Storage access is user-initiated for selecting photos and videos to edit. The app is a photo editor so this is core functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect visual information through the images that you post to our services, including your profile photos.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Picsart shares your data with service providers, advertising networks, government bodies when required, and its subsidiaries. Your data may also be used for interest-based advertising.
categories.detail: Data is shared with multiple third parties including service providers for hosting/security/analytics/advertising, ad networks for serving ads, government/law enforcement when legally required, and subsidiaries/affiliates. The policy also mentions potential sharing in mergers or acquisitions.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share your information with: Service providers we use to process information on our behalf... Ad networks and other ad serving providers... Government and law enforcement bodies... Our subsidiaries and affiliates.
concerns: Data shared with ad networks for targeted advertising
Shared with subsidiaries and affiliates
Potential transfer in mergers or acquisitions
Policy mentions selling or sharing data for targeted advertising

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You must provide personal details like name, email, and username to create an account. Your profile and posts are public by default, and your data may be used to target ads to you.
categories.detail: Account creation requires contact and identifying information. Demographic information may optionally be shared. Profile information and posts are publicly accessible. Third-party login data from Apple, Google, Facebook, Snapchat is collected. Account data is used for targeted advertising and profiling.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account we collect the information you provide us through text fields, including contact and other identifying information such as your first and last name, email address, username, and password... Market Picsart services and deliver targeted advertising to you... Your Picsart profile and the posts you make are publicly accessible.
concerns: Profile and posts are public by default
Account data used for targeted advertising
Demographic data collected for personalization
Data from third-party logins collected

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Picsart tracks how you use the app to show you personalized ads. It uses cookies, tracking pixels, and works with ad networks to follow your activity across different apps and websites.
categories.detail: Interest-based advertising is a core revenue model. The app uses cookies, tracking pixels, web beacons, and works with ad networks that collect data across platforms. Google Analytics, Firebase, Crashlytics, and Facebook analytics are used. Do Not Track signals are not recognized.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Ad Network may also serve advertisements to you using personal information, such as your email address, that they may collect directly from you both on our platform and on non-affiliated platforms... This type of advertising is known as interest-based advertising... Our systems do not recognize 'Do Not Track' signals.
concerns: Cross-platform behavioral tracking for ads
Do Not Track signals ignored
Multiple analytics and ad SDKs integrated
Advertising is a core part of the free experience

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Picsart says you must be at least 13 years old to use the app. If they learn someone under 13 has an account, they will delete it.
categories.detail: The policy states a 13+ age requirement and that services are not directed at children under 13. There is no detailed enforcement mechanism described beyond deletion if discovered.
categories.policy_excerpt: You are not allowed to use our services if you are under the age of 13, and our services are not directed at children under the age of 13. If we become aware that we have received personal Information from a person under the age of 13, we will delete this information and terminate the person's account.
concerns: No active age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Picsart automatically logs your internet activity including IP address, browser type, what you click on, and when you visit, to run and improve the service.
categories.detail: Log data is collected automatically including IP address, browser type and settings, date/time of visits, search terms, navigation within the app, and device data. This is standard server logging.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our servers passively keep an electronic record of your interactions with our services, which we call 'log data'... includes where you navigate within our website and apps, your IP address, browser type and settings, the date and time of your visit, search terms, which elements of our site and services you use the most, device data, and cookie data.
concerns: IP address collected and logged
Navigation and interaction data logged

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Picsart collects detailed information about your devices and combines it to understand how you use the app. This data is also used for advertising and analytics.
categories.detail: Device data and usage activity are collected and combined. This includes device identifiers and activity data used for analytics, personalization, and advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect and combine data about the devices you use to access Picsart, and data about your device usage and activity.
concerns: Device data combined across sessions
Used for advertising and analytics

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: When you use face effects, Picsart collects facial geometry data to apply the effect. It is stored on their servers for up to 3 years after your account becomes inactive, but they promise not to sell it or use it to identify you.
categories.detail: Biometric data (facial geometry) is collected for face effects. It is not used for identification or authentication. It is stored with reasonable care and destroyed after account termination or 3 years of inactivity. It may be disclosed to service providers and others under the general sharing policy.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you use Picsart tools and apply effects to, or generate images of, your face, you understand and agree that Picsart may use facial geometry or other facial data to produce the image or effect you request. We will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from your biometric data.
concerns: Biometric data stored on servers
May be disclosed under general sharing terms
Retained for up to 3 years of inactivity

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention storing your payment or credit card details directly. Subscriptions are likely handled by Apple's payment system.
categories.detail: While subscriptions are mentioned, there is no explicit statement that Picsart stores financial or payment card data. Payment processing is likely handled by third-party processors or Apple.
categories.policy_excerpt: Receive, process, and confirm your subscription or registration

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request deletion of your personal information through a form or by email. However, some data may be kept for legal reasons, security, or to finish transactions.
categories.detail: Data deletion is available via Privacy Request Form or email. The policy lists several exceptions where data may be retained, including legal requirements, security incidents, error correction, fraud prevention, and legitimate business purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Picsart provides you the option to delete the personal information we have collected about you... We may not be able to delete your personal information (i) if we have to complete an ongoing transaction with you, (ii) if we detect or need to address a data security incident...
concerns: Multiple exceptions to deletion
Some data retained for legal and security purposes

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Picsart may change its privacy policy at any time. If the changes are important, they might notify you by email, app notification, or on their website. If you keep using the app, you automatically agree to the new policy.
categories.detail: Material changes may be notified through the website, app, email, or push notifications. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the revised policy. There is no requirement for active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes, we may notify you through other methods as required by law... If you continue to use Picsart after those changes are in effect, you agree to the new policy.
concerns: Continued use equals automatic acceptance
